criteria.silhouette_scale: Open four-spoke wheel, horizontal cylinder, two supports and separate front cabinet preserve engine identity. Native geometry will establish exact proportions rather than trusting illustration perspective.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Box castings, 45-degree bevels and stepped fittings are implementable in the current Java/GeckoLib split. Tiny bevel highlights are texture treatment, not additional cubes.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Wheel shaft is transverse to the cylinder; clear space exists below the rim. Native review must verify the illustrated wheel-to-case separation and full rotation.
criteria.period_materials: Cast iron and machined steel dominate, with brass oil cup, bearing and gauge. Avoid carrying the illustration's ornamental brass foot trim into the model.
criteria.family_consistency: Gray castings and readable cream instrument match the refinery family. Material marks must remain quieter than the silhouette.
criteria.controls_readability: Separate gauge and lever communicate monitoring and control; do not copy the image's extra duplicated oil cup behind the wheel.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Same footprint, components, supplies and runtime behavior. This study improves modeling and evidence, not engine power or flight mechanics.
